title: Repurposing of a DNA segregation machinery into a cytoskeletal system controlling cell shape | Science
content: Bacteria, like eukaryotes, use conserved cytoskeletal systems for intracellular organization. The plasmid-encoded ParMRC system forms actin-like filaments that segregate low–copy number plasmids. In multicellular cyanobacteria such as Anabaena sp., we ...
